title: Specified identity-open inverse pullback compositor
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $T$, use its pulled-back coefficient ring $\Lambda_T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and internal module category $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], with the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the module inverse images of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. For arbitrary schemes $U,D,Z$, arrows $j:U\to Z$, $i:U\to D$ and $h:D\to Z$, and an equality $h\circ i=j$, define the natural isomorphism $a_h:i^*h^*\xrightarrow{\sim}j^*$ as the inverse of the specified pullback composition isomorphism $(h\circ i)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}i^*h^*$ [def-sfb-module-upper-star-comp], followed by equality transport from $(h\circ i)^*$ to $j^*$. The equality transport is the isomorphism induced by the given equality of scheme morphisms. This fixes the actual comparison, with no open-immersion, Cartesian, identity-locus, finite-type or coefficient-admissibility hypothesis.
